text: Mia comes to her family's remote cabin in the woods to quit heroin, watched over by her estranged brother David and three friends. In the cellar, among rotting animal corpses, they find an old book, and Eric [reads its incantation aloud|origin|deliberately called up]. Soon Mia is scalding herself in the shower and vomiting into her nurse's mouth, and the thing that has [taken hold of her|threat|being taken over] needs [five souls|wants|claiming souls and victims] before the [sky can rain blood|images|blood].
